subject.title: Slack: Show tool-level progress in assistant thread status

question: Should Slack native assistant-thread status update with per-tool labels, and if so should that be default, opt-in, or blocked until Slack-safe visibility policy lands?
rationale: Current main already has generic native loading messages plus separate tool-progress preview/reaction surfaces, and exposing tool names in Slack can be a product/security disclosure choice rather than a purely mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Approve safe per-tool status
options.body: Implement per-tool native status only after maintainers define the safe/default disclosure policy and how it interacts with existing loading messages and progress previews.

options.title: Keep generic native status
options.body: Leave native `assistant.threads.setStatus` generic and use draft previews/status reactions for detailed progress until a broader Slack progress policy is accepted.

options.title: Defer to custom status config
options.body: Handle this through the customizable Slack status/loading-message contract tracked by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/67129 instead of adding automatic tool labels now.

recommendation.title: Approve safe per-tool status
recommendation.body: Implement per-tool native status only after maintainers define the safe/default disclosure policy and how it interacts with existing loading messages and progress previews.
